## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user. Link an issue if relevant.

## Verification

Give commands/results, relevant calculations or rendered evidence, and skipped or
unavailable contexts. Follow the seven gates in the
[contribution guide](https://github.com/unluckyjet/GraphUnslopify/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
For scientific changes, explain the reference answers and assumptions. For layout
changes, inspect gallery results. For generator changes, refresh packaged resources.

## Limits and release scope

Explain material limitations, compatibility changes and source-only behavior after
the published release. Do not include credentials, private research data or
unverified claims about user testing, scientific validity or performance gains.
